capabilities.name: cancelTimer
capabilities.description: Cancel an active timer by its tag, so it will not fire. It starts no action and may accompany any decision, including idle. Failure: timer_not_found (no active timer has this tag).

tag.description: Tag of the timer to cancel.

capabilities.name: explore
capabilities.description: Explore unknown space on this agent's own map, in iterations: the frontiers (known free space next to unknown space) within radiusM of the agent first, then it travels to the nearest one left and starts the next iteration, until none is left in scope. Needs a range sensor (lidar or proximity); a UAV must be airborne and explores at its current altitude. region: a region ID from the space summary (e.g. r-03-05); omitted = the whole map. It limits which frontiers are targets, not the path. strategy: nearest (default) = nearest in a straight line; largest = most cells. radiusM: iteration radius in metres; omitted = the agent's configured radius. Searches are bounded to a window around the iteration, so an unreachable frontier costs the window, not the map: it is set aside for the iteration, retried from another centre with larger windows, and marked unreachable (until its map changes) after three centres. Succeeds with region_explored or frontier_exhausted (no reachable frontier left). Failures: unknown_region; no_map_data (no data at its own position after 2 s); geofence (a UAV would leave a geofence or its altitude limits).

preconditions.name: airborne
preconditions.description: The UAV is flying (after takeoff, before landing).

preconditions.name: hasRangeSensor
preconditions.description: The agent has a range sensor (lidar or proximity): without one it can never discover anything.

region.description: Region ID (r-<column>-<row>) to explore; omit for the whole map.

strategy.description: Target choice: nearest (straight-line distance, default) or largest (most frontier cells).

radiusM.description: Radius of an exploration iteration in metres; omit for the agent's configured radius.

groupsVisited.description: Frontier targets reached or resolved by sensing on the way.

groupsMarked.description: Frontier groups this action found unreachable.

xM.description: Metres east of the map origin (south-west corner).

yM.description: Metres north of the map origin.

zM.description: Altitude in metres above the ground datum (0 for ground vehicles).

capabilities.name: goTo
capabilities.description: Move to a target point. The vehicle plans a path around known obstacles with its configured planner and cost profile, then follows it. Coordinates are in the world frame: x metres east and y metres north of the map origin (the south-west corner). While the path is being computed the action is running in its planning phase; planning takes simulated time proportional to the search effort. A UAV must be airborne; altitudeM sets its cruise altitude (default: its current altitude). Ground vehicles must omit altitudeM. Failures: target_blocked: the target itself cannot hold this vehicle (an obstacle, a no-fly volume at that altitude, or too close to an obstacle for the vehicle's footprint). unreachable: the target is free but no path to it exists. kinematically_infeasible: a path exists but this ground vehicle cannot follow it (it only drives forwards and has a minimum turning radius, e.g. there is no room to turn around). planning_budget: planning ran out of its budget before finding a path.

capabilities.name: hold
capabilities.description: Stop and stay at the current position (a UAV hovers at its current altitude). With durationS the action succeeds after that many simulated seconds; without it, it runs until another action replaces it.

capabilities.name: land
capabilities.description: UAV only: descend vertically and land at the current position. Fails if the ground below is occupied.

preconditions.name: airborne
preconditions.description: The UAV is flying (after takeoff, before landing).

xM.description: Metres east of the map origin (south-west corner).

yM.description: Metres north of the map origin.

capabilities.name: returnToBase
capabilities.description: Plan a path to this agent's base and follow it; a UAV flies at its cruise altitude and lands on arrival. Requires a base. Failures (the base is the target): target_blocked: the target itself cannot hold this vehicle (an obstacle, a no-fly volume at that altitude, or too close to an obstacle for the vehicle's footprint). unreachable: the target is free but no path to it exists. kinematically_infeasible: a path exists but this ground vehicle cannot follow it (it only drives forwards and has a minimum turning radius, e.g. there is no room to turn around). planning_budget: planning ran out of its budget before finding a path. landing_blocked: a UAV cannot land at the base.

preconditions.description: The agent has a base assigned in the scenario.

landed.description: True for a UAV that landed at the base.

capabilities.name: setTimer
capabilities.description: Ask to be woken up later: after delayS seconds of simulated time you receive a timer event carrying this tag. It starts no action and may accompany any decision, including idle. Setting a tag that already exists replaces it. At most 8 timers can be active; delayS must be between 0.1 and 3600. Failures: delay_out_of_range, timer_limit.

delayS.description: Simulated seconds from now until the timer fires, between 0.1 and 3600.

tag.description: Name of the timer: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 32 characters.

capabilities.name: takeoff
capabilities.description: UAV only: climb vertically from the ground to altitudeM (metres above the ground datum). Fails if the altitude is outside the airspace limits of the map.

preconditions.name: grounded
preconditions.description: The UAV is on the ground.

altitudeM.description: Target altitude, metres above the ground datum.
